cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, New York, NY, 1962; Edith G. Halpert, New York, NY, 1966; (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, Forest Hills, New York, 1968 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March, 1946. . . . No signature [note of inscriptions 1, 2]. Have dated this ab. 1921 as O'Keeffe thinks the same as other apple group done at this time." Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, Dec. 1962." Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1921. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 19. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
